lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a faint grid-like arrangement on the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal ridge is visible across the upper-middle portion of the flank, showing a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow gradient on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, dark, elongated feature, consistent with a remora or temporal attachment, is visible on the mid-left section of the lateral flank.
